answer: Give every identity a private, seed-derived wander route each epoch: five ridge beacons visited in an order only its key can compute, each demanding a stranger-countersigned sighting within a short, unpredictable window. One beacon asks for the grooves on a walnut shell shown only there that hour; another for a light pattern flashed once. Clones cannot share a walk: routes diverge, windows overlap, and a copied or missed sighting breaks only that identity's chain — mass farming means mass walking, in person, every epoch.
